headline: Skubal's clock, a Marte deal that looks close and Webb on the block: nine days to the lockout and the stove is finally hot.

news.title: Angels sale to Stan Kroenke expected in early January
news.note: Arte Moreno is selling to the Rams and Nuggets owner. Manfred said the deal should close in early January.

news.title: Marte trade 'inevitable if not imminent'
news.note: Rosenthal and Sammon say Arizona will move its second baseman as it cuts payroll. Marte has 10-and-5 rights and can veto; the Orioles, Blue Jays, Red Sox and Rays are named.
San Francisco will now listen on its three-time All-Star, a reversal from the deadline. He's signed through 2028.
news.title: Giants open to trading Logan Webb

news.note: The 22-year-old outfielder is now under control through 2035. It's the Mets' first big long-term extension under Stearns.
news.title: Mets extend A.J. Ewing for eight years

news.note: Rosenthal and Sammon list the Rays, White Sox, Cubs, Padres, Blue Jays and two unknown clubs. He could sign before Skubal does.
news.title: Seven teams chase Freddy Peralta

news.note: Jim Duquette reported the offer; it would be the highest AAV ever for a free-agent starter. Skubal has met the Mets, Dodgers, Blue Jays, Padres and a fifth team over Zoom, and is expected to pick by Dec. 1.
news.title: Mets reportedly offer Skubal nine years, almost $400M
